vendors.reason: Has Romanian pages (menutiger.com/ro), but prices are USD only ("17US$/lună", "46US$/lună", "119US$/lună" on /ro/pricing) and neither /ro/pricing nor /ro/features/online-food-order-system mentions pickup / ridicare / la pachet or ordering ahead (only a bare "Programarea comenzilor" table label). No online ordering ahead shown, so not eligible. Borderline: /ro/features/web-site-builder has only an English FAQ line "accept takeout and delivery orders" (no ordering-ahead or pickup-time wording) and "Conectează ușor propriul domeniu sau subdomeniu."; kept not_relevant, as in the other countries checked today.

notes: Two eligible with own-site prices, both priced in EUR on their Romanian pages, not RON: 4SaleFood (food_truck; Start 5 / Plus 10 / Pro 20 EUR per month; the Romanian page says Romanian accounts are billed in lei at the BNR rate + 5%) and MenuForma (nearest_local; Regular 8.99 / Pro 44.99 EUR per month on the monthly toggle). 4SaleFood: the Romanian homepage lists "Interval orar și sloturi de livrare", but the English homepage's limits section says the shop has "no delivery time slots", so capacity is left not_mentioned. Its kds 'no' and domain 'yes' quotes come from the English homepage (https://4salefood.net). MenuForma: the Romanian page lists its features once, with no per-plan ticks; it says pickup/takeaway is in the paid plans, without naming which one. /ro/plans is a 404 and /plans rendered no plan text, so the prices come from the homepage pricing section; quotes are "€8.99" / "€44.99" because "/lună" sits in a separate element. Choice: 403 again (once today, as instructed), so the stored RON plans are unverified. Appy POS: bot check on both appy.ro and www.appy.ro. MENU TIGER: Romanian pages exist but prices are USD only and there is no ordering-ahead wording, so it's kept not_relevant. Not recorded: Zur (found only via App Store search results; Irish developer, support@zur.ie; a consumer food-truck app that appears to have moved to event booking; own site not read) and UpMenu (no Romanian page or prices found; not read).
